description: 重要河川污染情形 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 環境部. 本資料依全國及河川別統計重要河川監測結果，採用河川污染指數(River Pollution Index, RPI)，以水中溶氧量(DO)、生化需氧量(BOD5)、懸浮固體(SS)與氨氮(NH3-N）等4項水質參數之濃度值，來計算指數積分值，並分為未(稍)受污染、輕度污染、中度污染、嚴重污染等4種分類估算其河川長度，單位為公里。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 環境部. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
